job.command:
stardev
module purge module load fastjet-3.3.4 module load root-5.34.38
# Flatten jet_scale/ and shared/ into the job's working dir. cp jet_scale/* . cp shared/* .
set INDIR = "{{JETTREES_DIR}}" if ( "${INDIR}" !~ */ ) then set INDIR = "${INDIR}/" endif
echo "========================================" echo "JetTrees input dir = ${INDIR}" echo "Output JSON name = {{JSON_NAME}}" echo "========================================"
echo "Compiling JetEnergyScaleFineGrid_em_only..." g++ -m64 JetEnergyScaleFineGrid_em_only.cpp VectorDict.cxx -o JetEnergyScaleFineGrid_em_only \ `root-config --cflags --libs` \ `fastjet-config --cxxflags --libs` -std=c++11
echo "Running JetEnergyScaleFineGrid_em_only..." ./JetEnergyScaleFineGrid_em_only "${INDIR}"
echo "Compiling CalibrationMap_em_only..." g++ -m64 CalibrationMap_em_only.cpp -o CalibrationMap_em_only \ `root-config --cflags --libs` -std=c++11
echo "Running CalibrationMap_em_only..." ./CalibrationMap_em_only jet_calibration.root {{JSON_NAME}}
# Closure on the same UE-subtracted jets (weighted medians of E_corr / E_truth, # and the map against the medians it was fitted to) echo "Compiling jes_closure..." g++ -m64 -O2 jes_closure.cpp VectorDict.cxx -o jes_closure \ `root-config --cflags --libs` \ `fastjet-config --cxxflags --libs` -std=c++11 ls ${INDIR}*.root > closure_files.list ./jes_closure closure_files.list {{JSON_NAME}} ue jes_closure jet_calibration.root >&! jes_closure.txt tail -40 jes_closure.txt
if ( {{SAVE_CALIBRATION_ROOT}} == 0 ) then rm -f jet_calibration.root endif
echo "Files in scratch:" ls -l
